candidates.trace: ObjectiveExpression::new rejects empty expressions, empty paths, more than 16 paths or 32 leaves, repeated objective IDs and zero Defeat counts. Both ObjectiveExpression.alternatives and ObjectivePath.objectives are public, and the derived Deserialize has no try_from or equivalent validation attribute. A direct public literal with one empty path therefore bypasses new; pinned serde-derive struct source also shows direct field construction for the ordinary derived decoding path. In evaluate, the empty path maps to an empty progress list and its all(Satisfied) predicate is vacuously true, so the expression reports Satisfied even with no facts. This is source and logical reasoning; no method or decoder ran.
